# terrakube_policy_attachment (Data Source)

Query a Terrakube OPA Policy Attachment by policy set ID and target scope (workspace_id, project_id, tag_id) or attachment ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "terrakube_policy_set" "guardrails" {
  organization = "my-organization"
  name         = "blast-radius-guardrails"
}

# Look up the attachment of a policy set to a workspace.
data "terrakube_policy_attachment" "workspace" {
  policy_set_id = data.terrakube_policy_set.guardrails.id
  workspace_id  = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}

output "policy_attachment_id" {
  value = data.terrakube_policy_attachment.workspace.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `policy_set_id` (String) Target Policy Set ID

### Optional

- `id` (String) Attachment ID (UUID). Specify either id or a target scope.
- `project_id` (String) Attached Project ID
- `tag_id` (String) Attached Organization Tag ID
- `workspace_id` (String) Attached Workspace ID
